name: Cheese Tsunami 🧀
desc:
Can you survive the Cheese Tsunami? 🧀🌊

⚠️ Smell that? The cheese flood is coming - climb fast or get melted!
🎮 Control the cheesy wave with the button.
🧀 Longer wait = Bigger, cheesier wave!

scripts.title: auto xp
scripts.features: a auto level script it will auto get xp and auto level you up :  )
scripts.script:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SurvivedAWave = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("SurvivedAWave")

while true do
    SurvivedAWave:FireServer()
    wait(0.001) -- adjust to your liking but dont go to fast 
end
